ai.prompt:
Act as an expert shopping receipt data extractor.
      
      IMPORTANT CONTINUITY RULE:
      If you receive MULTIPLE IMAGES, they are parts of a SINGLE RECEIPT (a long receipt photographed in chunks). 
      - Merge all information into a single JSON object.
      - DO NOT DUPLICATE products if they appear in the overlap of photos.
      - Sum subtotals to verify the final total.

      EXPECTED PRODUCTS LIST: [{{lista}}].
      CURRENT DATE: {{fecha}}.

      CRITICAL RULES:
      1. "comercio": Must be a STRING (e.g., "WALMART"). Do not use long legal names, only the known trade name.
      2. "total": The final amount paid on the receipt.
      3. "nombre_base": Use the name from the EXPECTED PRODUCTS LIST if the receipt item matches semantically.

      STRICT JSON FORMAT:
      {
        "comercio": "string",
        "fecha": "DD/MM/AAAA",
        "total": number,
        "productos": [
          { "cantidad": number, "nombre_ticket": "string", "nombre_base": "string", "subtotal": number }
        ]
      }

help.home_desc: Here you can see how much you've spent this month. Tap the spend card to see a breakdown by category.
help.nav_desc: Use the bottom bar to move around: Home, the (+) button to upload receipts, and List for your pending items.
help.scanner_desc: Choose the store type. If the receipt is long, take several photos in parts; the AI will merge them all!
help.list_desc: Note down what you need. When scanning a receipt, the app will automatically check off what it finds.
help.settings_desc: In the top gear icon, you can export your expenses to Excel or watch this tutorial again.
help.tip_spend_card: Tap this card to see the category breakdown for the month. Use the ← → arrows to navigate between previous months.
help.tip_records: Tap any record to see the full detail: products, prices and the receipt photos saved in your Drive.
help.tip_list_input: Type the product name. The app searches the shared catalog and shows suggestions with the last price you paid and where.
help.tip_list_scan: If you have products in your list, tap this button to upload the receipt. The AI will cross-check and mark items automatically.
help.tip_scan_type: Choose the store type before uploading the receipt. This classifies the expense into the dashboard categories.
help.tip_scan_photos: Short receipt: one centered photo. Long receipt: 2-3 photos in sections (top, middle, bottom). The AI merges them automatically.
help.tip_review: Review the AI-extracted data before saving. You can edit the store name, date, products and prices. The magnifier button shows price history.
help.tip_settings_export: Download all your expenses as a CSV file to open in Excel, Google Sheets or any spreadsheet app.
help.tip_nav_plus: This is the central button. It takes you to the receipt upload module. Choose the store type and upload the photo.

pwa.banner_desc: Quick access from your home screen, without opening the browser
pwa.ios_step1_desc: In Safari, tap the share icon ↑ that appears in the bottom toolbar of the browser.
pwa.ios_step2_desc: Scroll up in the menu or tap the 'More' button to see all available options.
pwa.ios_step3_desc: Find and tap the 'Add to Home Screen' option in the action menu list.
pwa.ios_step4_desc: Verify that 'Open as web app' is enabled and tap the 'Add' button to complete the installation.
